craft_notes: Sthāyin: neither-nor (negation of motion). Sanskrit: na vrajen na viśec...bhāvayet?? no — bhrānta? — T1: na vrajen na viśec + nirvikalpatayā madhye tayā bhairavarūpatā → L4 preserves double na. Rows: row 1 (neither-nor). Close: by-her (agency echoes v25). Rejected: 'becomes still' — killed: go/enter explicitly denied (motion named to refuse it); 'spontaneously' — killed: thoughtlessness kept (nirvikalpa).

lines: Neither should it go nor enter, wind-blossomed power:
by thoughtlessness in middle — Bhairava-formness, by her.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na vrajen na viśec chaktir marudrūpā vikāsite | nirvikalpatayā madhye tayā bhairavarūpatā

reads_against.argmap: What happens when the wind-power blossoms? → Neither going nor entering — Bhairava-form arises by thoughtlessness.
c1_essence: Blossomed power neither goes nor enters: Bhairava-form by thoughtlessness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
